text:
Nina (Docs): FYI publish failed: linkcheck complaining about anchors for headings containing code. Example: `## `Client.get()` helper` caused a broken anchor. CI excerpt: 

```
WARN Broken anchor: /docs/sdk#`Client.get()` -> not found
```

Ravi (DevEx): This happens after we migrated from MkDocs. Different slug rules. Fast fix is to add an explicit id on the heading like `{#client-get}`.

Lena (Platform): Agreed. We also need a longer-term fix so build and linkcheck compute slugs the same way. Proposal: add a rehype-slug config with a deterministic slugify (strip punctuation, lowercase, hyphenate).

Nina (Docs): I opened a tiny patch that adds ids to the three impacted pages (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4952) and updated internal links to those ids. CI re-run shows those errors cleared.

CI-Bot: linkcheck job 4952 finished  3 remaining warnings (external redirects).

Ravi (DevEx): I'll add an advisory lint that warns when a heading contains backticks or parentheses and suggests adding `{#...}`. We can make it an error after a one-week grace period.

Lena (Platform): I'll prototype the canonical slug plugin in infra and run it on the full site to see if it introduces regressions. If it matches old MkDocs slugs we can flip linkcheck to use it too.

Nina (Docs): Thanks. Closing this thread once the infra PR is opened.
